marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 30 knots diminishing to southeast 15 this evening
and to light late overnight. Wind light Sunday. Rain beginning near midnight changing to periods of drizzle
Sunday morning with a risk of freezing drizzle. Fog patches forming this evening
and dissipating Sunday evening. Temperatures plus 5 falling to zero Sunday
morning. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 2 to 3 metres subsiding to 1 near
midnight.<br/>
